item.title: Pixels of the Week – November 8, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week we explore if AI could make the open web disappear, if a dialog should close on outside click (plot twist: it depends), and we tag along flights in the sky. And don’t miss the fun pigeon armchair and portraits of people who dress alike.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – November 1, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week sadly explores how buying online became a nightmare, from deceptive patterns to AI slop. Also, don't miss a fun history guessing game, colorful tufting art, and a book on feminist approaches to type, and my Golden Honey Suckle color.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – October 25, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week we explore the “disability dongle” problem, ecommerce accessibility issues that get customers stuck, and the double-edged sword of AI-generated prototypes. Also, don’t miss some horror graphic novels for Halloween and a gaming database for parents!

item.title: Pixels of the Week – October 18, 2026
item.content:encoded: This edition explores agentic commerce interfaces beyond chat UIs. Don't miss a fun clock made from trash, a webcam theremin experiment, cool dataviz and tool to know if a book chapter will make you sad.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – October 11, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week brings some resources on neurodiversity and cognitive accessibility, explains why design struggles to justify its value to business, and how AI exposes design’s craft crisis. Also don't miss some nice accessible color combinations and funny wildlife photos.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – October 4, 2026
item.content:encoded: 👉🏻 Curated weekly UX Research, Design & Tech resources: building a general-purpose accessibility agent, how to make your design system AI-ready, WCAG 3.3.4 error prevention explained, why you got faster but your company didn't, the AI delegation matrix for your UI, flame painting art on copper, curated branding inspiration, how mechanical watches work, maps of book characters' journeys, free no-login utility tools.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – September 6, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week we cover accessibility ownership from design to development and why enterprise UX patterns matter for AI and power users. Also, an interesting IKEA complexity index, tech ad archive, whimsical cat art, and a nine-tailed fox book.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – August 30, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week covers why design systems need people, not just docs, and how spec-driven design can help document research insights. Also don't miss a fun cringe LinkedIn bullshit post creator, and an interface cheat sheet.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – August 23, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week we explore design systems beyond pattern libraries, AI’s impact on software work, and disability acceptance. Also don't miss inclusive stock photos, amazing medieval illustrations, and a creative recipe flow diagram.

item.title: Pixels of the Week – August 16, 2026
item.content:encoded: This week we explore creative provenance and trust in the age of AI generated content. Also don't miss 3 amazing illustrators you must follow, the design of the new European banknotes and an ongoing reference library for Black hairstyles.
